site_name: Bus Shelter 0096 And Advertising Right Adjacent 70
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed TfL Shelter Specification; Drawings; Cover letter; uploaded 29th June 2026. . 
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme.

Condition : 2 - The maximum steady brightness of the projecting sign hereby permitted is not to exceed 300 candelas per sq.m. 
Reason: To ensure the proposed sign does not have an adverse effect on the amenity of the area in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with paragraph 141 of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 3 - The illumination of the signs hereby permitted shall be by static illumination only. 
Reason: In the interest of highway safety and of the visual amenities of the locality in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with paragraph 141 of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 4 - The advertisement hereby approved shall not display any animated or video content unless it is below the VAMM maximum threshold.
Reason: In the interest of highway safety and of the visual amenities of the locality in accordance with the Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 5 - INFORMATIVE: The footway and carriageway of West Hill should not be blocked during the relocation and installation works. Temporary obstructions during the development works should be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrians or obstruct the flow of traffic on West Hill. All vehicles should only park/stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions.
description: Display of internally illuminated sequential advertisement display capable of static and dynamic content with automatic rotation of images.
